        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  const loadSources = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!projectId) return;\n    try {\n      // 获取项目的来源信息\n      const response = await api.get('/source-information', {\n        params: {\n          pageType: &#96;project-${projectId}&#96;,\n          page: 1,\n          pageSize: 100\n        }\n      });\n      if (response.data.success &amp;&amp; response.data.data) {\n        setSources(response.data.data);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载来源信息失败:', error);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const loadTechPoints = async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await techPointService.getTechPoints({\n        page: 1,\n        pageSize: 100\n      });\n      if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n        setTechPoints(response.data.data || []);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载技术点失败:', error);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const loadKnowledgePoints = async (techPointIds: number[]) =&gt; {\n    if (techPointIds.length === 0) {\n      setKnowledgePoints([]);\n      return;\n    }\n    try {\n      // 加载所有选中技术点的知识点\n      const allKnowledgePoints: KnowledgePoint[] = [];\n      for (const techPointId of techPointIds) {\n        const response = await knowledgePointService.getByTechPointId(techPointId, {\n          page: 1,\n          pageSize: 100\n        });\n        if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n          // response.data 是知识点数组\n          allKnowledgePoints.push(...response.data);\n        }\n      }\n      setKnowledgePoints(allKnowledgePoints);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载知识点失败:', error);\n    }\n  };\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (selectedTechPoints.length &gt; 0) {\n      loadKnowledgePoints(selectedTechPoints);\n    } else {\n      setKnowledgePoints([]);\n    }\n  }, [selectedTechPoints]);\n\n  // 点击外部关闭下拉菜单\n  useEffect\n\n;",

        },
        "contents": "const HomePage: React.FC = \n;\n\n  const loadProjects = async (forceLoadAll = false) =&gt; {\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      // 加载精选项目\n      const featuredResponse = await projectService.getFeaturedProjects(4);\n      if (featuredResponse.success &amp;&amp; featuredResponse.data) {\n        setFeaturedProjects(featuredResponse.data);\n      }\n\n      // 加载最近项目\n      const recentResponse = await projectService.getRecentProjects(20);\n      if (recentResponse.success &amp;&amp; recentResponse.data) {\n        setRecentProjects(recentResponse.data);\n      }\n\n      // 加载所有项目（用于\"全部\"和\"我的项目\"标签，或强制加载时）\n      if (forceLoadAll || activeTab === 'all' || activeTab === 'my') {\n        const allResponse = await projectService.getProjects({\n          page: 1,\n          pageSize: 100,\n          orderBy: sortBy === 'recent' ? 'last_opened_at' : sortBy === 'name' ? 'name' : 'created_at',\n          orderDirection: sortBy === 'recent' ? 'DESC' : 'ASC'\n        });\n        if (allResponse.success &amp;&amp; allResponse.data) {\n          setAllProjects(allResponse.data.data);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载项目失败:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleCreateProject = async (data: ProjectFormData) =&gt; {\n    const response = await projectService.createProject(data);\n    if (response.success) {\n      // 创建成功后，切换到\"我的项目\"标签页以显示新创建的项目\n      setActiveTab('my');\n      // 强制重新加载所有数据（包括所有项目列表）\n      await loadProjects(true);\n    } else {\n      alert(response.error || '创建项目失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleProjectClick = async (project: Project) =&gt; {\n    // 更新最后打开时间\n    await projectService.updateLastOpenedAt(project.id);\n    // 导航到项目资源管理页面\n    navigate(&#96;/project/${project.id}/resources&#96;);\n  };\n\n  const handleProjectMenuClick = (e: React.MouseEvent, project: Project)\n;\n;",

        "contents": "export const workflowAPI = {\nasync (query: string, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&lt;WorkflowResponse&gt; =&gt; {\n\n    }\n  },\n\n  // 技术包装\n  techPackage: async (searchResults: any, template?: string, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&lt;WorkflowResponse&gt; =&gt; {\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('techPackage');\n\n    try {\n      let inputs: any;\n\n      if (searchResults &amp;&amp; typeof searchResults === 'object' &amp;&amp; searchResults.query) {\n        inputs = {\n          query: searchResults.query,\n          selectedKnowledgePoints: searchResults.selectedKnowledgePoints,\n        };\n      } else {\n        inputs = {\n          searchResults: searchResults,\n          template: template,\n        };\n      }\n\n      const requestData: any = { inputs };\n      if (conversationId) {\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\n      }\n\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\"/workflow/tech-package\", requestData, {\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\n      });\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\n    } catch (error) {\n      return handleApiError(\"Tech package API\", error);\n    }\n  },\n\n  // 技术策略\n  techStrategy: async (techPackage: any, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&lt;WorkflowResponse&gt; =&gt; {\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('techStrategy');\n\n    try {\n      const requestData: any = {\n        inputs: { techPackage },\n      };\n      if (conversationId) {\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\n      }\n\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\"/workflow/tech-strategy\", requestData, {\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\n      });\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\n    } catch (error) {\n      return handleApiError(\"Tech strategy API\", error);\n    }\n  },\n\n  // 推广策略\n  promotionStrategy:\n,\n};",

        "contents": "      width: 244\n    - data:\n        context:\n          enabled: false\n          variable_selector: []\n        desc: 针对技术信息进行转译，让用户更容易理解\n        model:\n          completion_params:\n            temperature: 0.7\n          mode: chat\n          name: gpt-4o\n          provider: langgenius/openai/openai\n        prompt_template:\n        - id: bedafe78-7ce4-4017-aa02-98758be42d52\n          role: system\n          text: '你是一位专业的技术翻译专家，擅长将复杂的技术原理转化为普通用户能够理解的清晰表达。\n\n\n            **核心使命：**\n\n            将晦涩难懂的技术术语、复杂的工作原理、抽象的技术概念，翻译成生动易懂、逻辑清晰的日常语言，让非技术背景的用户也能快速理解技术本质。\n\n\n            **翻译原则：**\n\n            1. **保持技术准确性**：翻译过程不能改变技术事实和核心原理\n\n            2. **降低理解门槛**：用生活化的比喻和具体的例子解释抽象概念\n\n            3. **突出核心价值**：让用户明白\"这个技术是做什么的\"、\"为什么重要\"\n\n            4. **循序渐进**：从简单概念入手，逐步深入技术细节\n\n            5. **避免行话堆砌**：减少专业术语，必要时提供通俗解释\n\n            '\n        - id: f5cab65d-29fa-4e06-a0db-559f407dc479\n          role: user\n          text: '**翻译目标**: 将知识库检索到的技术信息，转化为用户友好的通俗表达\n\n\n            **输入材料**:\n\n            - 用户问题：{{#sys.query#}}",

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \n\n\n  const handleSelectionChange = (selectedIds: string[]) =&gt; {\n    setSelectedSourceIds(selectedIds);\n  };\n\n  const handleCreateConversation = useCallback(async (): Promise&lt;Conversation | null&gt; =&gt; {\n    try {\n      clearGlobalError();\n      \n      // 如果已有当前对话，直接返回，避免重复创建\n      if (currentConversation) {\n        console.log('[ConversationDebug] 已有当前对话，跳过创建:', currentConversation.id);\n        return currentConversation;\n      }\n      \n      const selectedSources = sources.filter((s) =&gt; selectedSourceIds.includes(s.id));\n      console.log('[ConversationDebug] 创建新对话，来源数量:', selectedSources.length);\n\n      const conversation = await aiSearchService.createConversation({\n        title: &#96;对话 ${new Date().toLocaleString('zh-CN', { year: 'numeric', month: 'numeric', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' }).replace(/\\//g, '/')}&#96;,\n        sources: selectedSources,\n        pageType: config.pageType,\n      });\n\n      console.log('[ConversationDebug] 新对话已创建:', conversation.id);\n\n      if (selectedWorkflowId) {\n        persistWorkflowSelection(selectedWorkflowId, conversation.id);\n      }\n      await loadConversations({ activeConversationId: conversation.id });\n      return conversation;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"创建对话失败:\", error);\n      reportError(\"创建对话失败，请稍后重试\", error instanceof Error ? error.message : undefined);\n      return null;\n    }\n  }, [\n    clearGlobalError,\n    sources,\n    selectedSourceIds,\n    reportError,\n    selectedWorkflowId,\n    persistWorkflowSelection,\n    loadConversations,\n    currentConversation,\n  ]);\n\n  const handleCreateNewConversation = useCallback\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \n\n\n  // 加载页面类型的来源信息（作为基础来源，始终保留）\n  const loadPageTypeSources = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      console.log('[SourceInfo] 开始加载页面类型来源信息:', config.pageType);\n      const sourceResult = await sourceService.loadSourceInformationByPageType(config.pageType);\n      console.log('[SourceInfo] 加载结果:', {\n        success: sourceResult.success,\n        count: sourceResult.data?.length || 0,\n        error: sourceResult.error\n      });\n      \n      if (sourceResult.success &amp;&amp; sourceResult.data &amp;&amp; sourceResult.data.length &gt; 0) {\n        console.log('[SourceInfo] 加载到的来源:', sourceResult.data.map(s =&gt; ({ id: s.id, title: s.title })));\n        setSources(prev =&gt; {\n          // 合并现有来源和数据库中的来源，避免重复\n          const sourceMap = new Map&lt;string, Source&gt;();\n          // 先添加现有来源\n          prev.forEach(s =&gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\n          // 再添加数据库中的来源（会覆盖重复的）\n          sourceResult.data!.forEach(s =&gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\n          const merged = Array.from(sourceMap.values());\n          console.log('[SourceInfo] 合并后的来源数量:', merged.length);\n          return merged;\n        });\n      } else if (sourceResult.error) {\n        console.warn('[SourceInfo] 加载失败:', sourceResult.error);\n      } else {\n        console.log('[SourceInfo] 没有找到页面类型的来源信息');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"[SourceInfo] 加载页面类型来源信息失败:\", error);\n      // 不阻止页面加载，只记录错误\n    }\n  }, [config.pageType]);\n\n  const loadFiles = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    try\n  };\n;",

      "codeBlock": {

        },
        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  const loadSources = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!projectId) return;\n    try {\n      // 获取项目的来源信息\n      const response = await api.get('/source-information', {\n        params: {\n          pageType: &#96;project-${projectId}&#96;,\n          page: 1,\n          pageSize: 100\n        }\n      });\n      if (response.data.success &amp;&amp; response.data.data) {\n        setSources(response.data.data);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载来源信息失败:', error);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const loadTechPoints = async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await techPointService.getTechPoints({\n        page: 1,\n        pageSize: 100\n      });\n      if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n        setTechPoints(response.data.data || []);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载技术点失败:', error);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const loadKnowledgePoints = async (techPointIds: number[]) =&gt; {\n    if (techPointIds.length === 0) {\n      setKnowledgePoints([]);\n      return;\n    }\n    try {\n      // 加载所有选中技术点的知识点\n      const allKnowledgePoints: KnowledgePoint[] = [];\n      for (const techPointId of techPointIds) {\n        const response = await knowledgePointService.getByTechPointId(techPointId, {\n          page: 1,\n          pageSize: 100\n        });\n        if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n          // response.data 是知识点数组\n          allKnowledgePoints.push(...response.data);\n        }\n      }\n      setKnowledgePoints(allKnowledgePoints);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载知识点失败:', error);\n    }\n  };\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (selectedTechPoints.length &gt; 0) {\n      loadKnowledgePoints(selectedTechPoints);\n    } else {\n      setKnowledgePoints([]);\n    }\n  }, [selectedTechPoints]);\n\n  // 点击外部关闭下拉菜单\n  useEffect\n\n;",

        "contents": "export const workflowAPI = {\nasync (query: string, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&lt;WorkflowResponse&gt; =&gt; {\n\n    }\n  },\n\n  // 技术包装\n  techPackage: async (searchResults: any, template?: string, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&lt;WorkflowResponse&gt; =&gt; {\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('techPackage');\n\n    try {\n      let inputs: any;\n\n      if (searchResults &amp;&amp; typeof searchResults === 'object' &amp;&amp; searchResults.query) {\n        inputs = {\n          query: searchResults.query,\n          selectedKnowledgePoints: searchResults.selectedKnowledgePoints,\n        };\n      } else {\n        inputs = {\n          searchResults: searchResults,\n          template: template,\n        };\n      }\n\n      const requestData: any = { inputs };\n      if (conversationId) {\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\n      }\n\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\"/workflow/tech-package\", requestData, {\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\n      });\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\n    } catch (error) {\n      return handleApiError(\"Tech package API\", error);\n    }\n  },\n\n  // 技术策略\n  techStrategy: async (techPackage: any, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&lt;WorkflowResponse&gt; =&gt; {\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('techStrategy');\n\n    try {\n      const requestData: any = {\n        inputs: { techPackage },\n      };\n      if (conversationId) {\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\n      }\n\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\"/workflow/tech-strategy\", requestData, {\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\n      });\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\n    } catch (error) {\n      return handleApiError(\"Tech strategy API\", error);\n    }\n  },\n\n  // 推广策略\n  promotionStrategy:\n,\n};",

        "contents": "-- 来源信息表\n-- 用于存储通过 SourceSidebar 添加的信息（包括文本来源和外部来源）\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS source_information (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    source_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COMMENT '来源唯一标识（前端生成的ID）',\n    title TEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '来源标题',\n    type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('knowledge_base', 'external')) COMMENT '来源类型：knowledge_base=知识库，external=外部来源',\n    url TEXT COMMENT '外部来源URL（仅external类型）',\n    description TEXT COMMENT '来源描述/内容',\n    page_type TEXT COMMENT '页面类型：tech-package, press-release, tech-strategy, tech-article',\n    conversation_id TEXT COMMENT '关联的对话ID',\n    metadata TEXT COMMENT '元数据（JSON格式）',\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')) COMMENT '状态',\n    created_by TEXT COMMENT '创建人',\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 创建索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_source_id ON source_information(source_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_type ON source_information(type);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_page_type ON source_information(page_type);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_conversation_id ON source_information(conversation_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_status ON source_information(status);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_created_at ON source_information(created_at);",

        "contents": "const sourceService = {\n,\n\n  /**\n   * 保存来源信息到数据库\n   */\n  async saveSourceInformation(\n    source: Source,\n    pageType?: string,\n    conversationId?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;{\n    success: boolean;\n    data?: SourceInformation;\n    error?: string;\n  }&gt; {\n    try {\n      const sourceInfo: Partial&lt;SourceInformation&gt; = {\n        source_id: source.id,\n        title: source.title,\n        type: source.type,\n        url: source.url,\n        description: source.description,\n        page_type: pageType as any,\n        conversation_id: conversationId,\n        status: \"active\",\n      };\n\n      const response = await api.post(\"/source-information\", sourceInfo);\n      return {\n        success: response.data.success,\n        data: response.data.data,\n        error: response.data.error,\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"保存来源信息失败:\", error);\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        error: \"保存来源信息失败\",\n      };\n    }\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 批量保存来源信息到数据库\n   */\n  async saveSourceInformationBatch(\n    sources: Source[],\n    pageType?: string,\n    conversationId?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;{\n    success: boolean;\n    data?: SourceInformation[];\n    error?: string;\n  }&gt; {\n    \n  }\n,\n};",

        "range": {

          "endPosition": {
            "line": 66
          }
        },
        "contents": "# 外部来源文本内容作为附加信息传递给 Dify\n\n## 功能说明\n\n当在 SourceSidebar 中勾选外部来源（文本类型）时，文本内容会**仅在第一次对话时**作为附加信息合并到查询中，传递给 Dify API。后续对话中不会再次带入附加信息。\n\n## 实现原理\n\n### 1. 前端处理\n\n- **AddTextModal**: 用户通过\"粘贴已复制的文字\"添加文本来源时，&#96;description&#96; 字段会包含完整的文本内容\n- **DialogueContent**: 发送消息时，会将 &#96;sources&#96; 数组传递到后端\n\n### 2. 后端处理\n\n**位置**: &#96;backend/src/modules/ai-search/application/useCases/SendMessage.usecase.ts&#96;\n\n**buildConversationData 方法**:\n\n1. **判断是否是第一次对话**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   const isFirstMessage = !params.conversation || \n                         !params.conversation.messages || \n                         params.conversation.messages.length === 0;\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **仅在第一次对话时提取外部来源文本**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   if (isFirstMessage) {\n     const externalTextSources = effectiveSources.filter((s: any) =&gt; \n       s.type === 'external' &amp;&amp; s.description &amp;&amp; s.description.trim()\n     );\n     // ... 构建附加信息\n   }\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **构建附加信息**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   if (externalTextSources.length &gt; 0) {\n     const textContents: string[] = [];\n     externalTextSources.forEach((source: any) =&gt; {\n       if (source.description &amp;&amp; source.description.trim()) {\n         const title = source.title || '附加信息';\n         textContents.push(&#96;【${title}】\\n${source.description.trim()}&#96;);\n       }\n     });\n     \n     additionalContext = '\\n\\n=== 附加信息 ===\\n' + textContents.join('\\n\\n---\\n\\n');\n   }\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. **合并到查询**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   let finalQuery = params.content;\n   if (additionalContext) {\n     finalQuery = params.content + additionalContext;\n   }\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. 数据流\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n用户勾选外部来源（文本类型）\n    ↓\nDialogueContent 发送消息（包含 sources）\n    ↓",

        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  // 点击外部关闭下拉菜单\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) =&gt; {\n      if (techPointSelectorRef.current &amp;&amp; !techPointSelectorRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {\n        setShowTechPointSelector(false);\n      }\n    };\n\n    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);\n    return () =&gt; {\n      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);\n    };\n  }, []);\n\n  const handleFileUpload = async (files: FileList | null) =&gt; {\n    if (!files || files.length === 0 || !projectId) return;\n    \n    setIsUploading(true);\n    try {\n      const fileArray = Array.from(files);\n      // 上传文件\n      const uploadedFiles = await aiSearchService.uploadFiles(fileArray, undefined);\n      \n      // 创建来源信息记录\n      for (const uploadedFile of uploadedFiles) {\n        // 如果markdown内容太长，只保存摘要\n        let description = &#96;文件大小: ${formatFileSize(uploadedFile.size)}&#96;;\n        if (uploadedFile.markdownContent) {\n          // 只保存前500个字符作为描述，完整内容保留在文件记录中\n          const contentPreview = uploadedFile.markdownContent.length &gt; 500\n            ? uploadedFile.markdownContent.substring(0, 500) + '...'\n            : uploadedFile.markdownContent;\n          description = contentPreview;\n        }\n        \n        await api.post('/source-information', {\n          source_id: uploadedFile.id || uploadedFile.fileId || &#96;file_${Date.now()}&#96;,\n          title: uploadedFile.name,\n          type: 'external',\n          url: uploadedFile.url,\n          description: description,\n          page_type: &#96;project-${projectId}&#96;,\n          conversation_id: null\n        });\n      }\n      \n      // 重新加载来源列表\n      await loadSources();\n      \n      // 清空文件输入\n      if (fileInputRefModal.current) {\n        fileInputRefModal.current.value = '';\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('文件上传失败:', error);\n      alert('文件上传失败，请重试');\n    }\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const SourceSidebar: React.FC&lt;SourceSidebarProps&gt; = \n\n\n  const handleDeleteSource = (sourceId: string, e: React.MouseEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.stopPropagation(); // 阻止事件冒泡，防止触发编辑弹窗\n    if (onSourcesChange) {\n      const newSources = sources.filter((s) =&gt; s.id !== sourceId);\n      onSourcesChange(newSources);\n      if (onSelectionChange) {\n        onSelectionChange(\n          selectedSources.filter((id) =&gt; id !== sourceId)\n        );\n      }\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleAddExternalSource = (newSource: Omit&lt;Source, \"id\"&gt;) =&gt; {\n    const source: Source = {\n      ...newSource,\n      id: &#96;external_${Date.now()}&#96;,\n    };\n    if (onSourcesChange) {\n      onSourcesChange([...sources, source]);\n    }\n    setShowAddModal(false);\n  };\n\n  const handleAddTextSource = (newSource: Omit&lt;Source, \"id\"&gt;) =&gt; {\n    const source: Source = {\n      ...newSource,\n      id: &#96;text_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}&#96;, // 确保ID唯一\n    };\n    if (onSourcesChange) {\n      onSourcesChange([...sources, source]);\n    }\n    // 默认选中新添加的来源\n    if (onSelectionChange) {\n      onSelectionChange([...selectedSources, source.id]);\n    }\n    setShowTextModal(false);\n  };\n\n  const handleSelectFromKnowledgeBase = (selectedItems: any[]) =&gt; {\n    const newSources: Source[] = selectedItems.map((item) =&gt; ({\n      id: &#96;kb_${item.id}&#96;,\n      title: item.title || item.techPoint || \"未命名知识点\",\n      type: \"knowledge_base\" as const,\n      description: item.description,\n    }));\n    if (onSourcesChange) {\n      onSourcesChange([...sources, ...newSources]);\n    }\n    setShowKnowledgeBrowser(false);\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"w-64 h-full bg-white border-r border-gray-200 flex flex-col\n;",

        "contents": "// 批量创建来源信息\nrouter.post('/batch', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const dataList: CreateSourceInformationDTO[] = req.body;\n    \n    if (!Array.isArray(dataList) || dataList.length === 0) {\n      return res.status(400).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '请提供有效的来源信息数组'\n      });\n    }\n\n    // 验证每个数据项\n    for (const data of dataList) {\n      if (!data.source_id || !data.title || !data.type) {\n        return res.status(400).json({\n          success: false,\n          message: '每个来源信息必须包含source_id、title和type字段'\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    const results = await sourceInformationService.createSourceInformationBatch(dataList);\n    \n    res.status(201).json({\n      success: true,\n      data: results,\n      message: &#96;成功创建${results.length}条来源信息&#96;\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('批量创建来源信息失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: '批量创建来源信息失败',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// 获取来源信息列表（必须在参数路由之前）\nrouter.get",

需要逐个执行语句\n      const statements = [\n        &#96;CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS source_information (\n          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n          source_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n          title TEXT NOT NULL,\n          type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('knowledge_base', 'external')),\n          url TEXT,\n          description TEXT,\n          page_type TEXT,\n          conversation_id TEXT,\n          metadata TEXT,\n          status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n          created_by TEXT,\n          created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n          updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n        )&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_source_id ON source_information(created_at)&#96;\n      ];\n      \n      for (const sql of statements) {\n        try {\n          await db.query(sql);\n        } catch (error: any) {\n          // 忽略表或索引已存在的错误\n console.error('初始化来源信息表失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "DialogueContent 发送消息（包含 sources）\n    ↓\nSendMessageUseCase.buildConversationData\n    ├─ 提取外部来源的 description（文本内容）\n    ├─ 构建附加信息字符串\n    └─ 合并到 query 中\n    ↓\n工作流输入（query 包含附加信息）\n    ↓\nDify API（query 包含附加信息）\n    ↓\nAI 处理（能够看到附加信息）\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 使用示例\n\n### 用户操作\n\n1. 在 SourceSidebar 中点击\"添加信息\"\n2. 选择\"粘贴已复制的文字\"\n3. 粘贴文本：\"千里浩瀚智能安全辅助驾驶系统 2025年3月3日，吉利正式发布了千里浩瀚智能安全辅助驾驶系统...\"\n4. 点击\"插入\"\n5. 勾选该外部来源\n6. 发送消息：\"请分析这个信息\"\n\n### 实际发送的 query\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n请分析这个信息\n\n=== 附加信息 ===\n【千里浩瀚智能安全辅助驾驶系统 2025年3月3日，吉利正式发布了千里浩瀚智能安全辅助驾驶系统...】\n千里浩瀚智能安全辅助驾驶系统 2025年3月3日，吉利正式发布了千里浩瀚智能安全辅助驾驶系统（简称...\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 日志记录\n\n### 提取日志\n\n**第一次对话时的日志标识**: &#96;提取外部来源文本内容作为附加信息（仅第一次对话）&#96;\n\n**日志内容**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"isFirstMessage\": true,\n  \"sourcesCount\": 1,\n  \"totalTextLength\": 500,\n  \"sources\": [\n    {\n      \"id\": \"text_xxx\",\n      \"title\": \"千里浩瀚智能安全辅助驾驶系统...\",\n      \"descriptionLength\": 500\n    }\n  ]\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**后续对话时的日志标识**: &#96;检测到外部来源文本，但非第一次对话，跳过附加信息&#96;\n\n**日志内容**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"isFirstMessage\": false,\n  \"messageCount\": 2,\n  \"sourcesCount\": 1\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 合并日志\n\n**日志标识**: &#96;合并附加信息到查询内容&#96;\n\n**日志内容**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"originalLength\": 10,\n  \"additionalLength\": 500,\n  \"finalLength\": 510\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 验证方法\n\n1. **查看后端日志**: 查找 &#96;提取外部来源文本内容作为附加信息&#96; 和 &#96;合并附加信息到查询内容&#96; 日志\n2. **检查 query 内容**: 确认 query 中包含 &#96;=== 附加信息 ===&#96; 标记和完整的文本内容",

0) {\n            console.log('[SourceInfo] 删除来源:', deletedSourceIds.length, '个');\n            for (const sourceId of deletedSourceIds) {\n              const result = await sourceService.deleteSourceInformation(sourceId);\n              if (!result.success) {\n                console.error('[SourceInfo] 删除来源失败:', sourceId, result.error);\n              }\n            }\n          }\n        } catch (error) {\n          console.error(\"[SourceInfo] 保存来源信息失败:\", error);\n          // 不阻止用户操作，只记录错误\n        }\n      })();\n      \n      return newSources;\n    });\n  }, [currentConversation?.id, config.pageType]);\n\n  const handleSelectionChange = (selectedIds: string[]) =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "export const buildConversationContext = (\n  messages: ConversationMessage[] = [],\n  options?: ConversationContextOptions\n): ConversationContextResult =&gt; {\n  const historyLimit = options?.historyLimit ?? DEFAULT_HISTORY_LIMIT;\n  const effectiveHistory = pickHistoryWindow(messages, historyLimit);\n\n  return {\n    summary: buildConversationSummary(effectiveHistory),\n    keyPhrases: extractKeyPhrases(effectiveHistory),\n    history: effectiveHistory.map((msg) =&gt; ({\n      id: msg.id,\n      role: msg.role,\n      content: msg.content,\n      createdAt: msg.createdAt instanceof Date ? msg.createdAt.toISOString() : msg.createdAt,\n      hasOutputs: Boolean(msg.outputs &amp;&amp; Object.keys(msg.outputs).length &gt; 0),\n    })),\n    historySize: effectiveHistory.length,\n    // 当 historyLimit &lt;= 0 时，表示全部历史，返回实际消息数量；否则返回限制值\n    historyLimit: historyLimit &lt;= 0 ? effectiveHistory.length : Math.min(historyLimit, MAX_HISTORY_LIMIT),\n  };\n};",

        "contents": "export class ContextManager {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 混合策略：结合窗口和Token控制\n   */\n  private async applyHybridStrategy(\n    history: any[],\n    strategy: DirectAgentConfig['contextStrategy'],\n    currentQuery: string\n  ): Promise&lt;ChatMessage[]&gt; {\n    const maxTokens = strategy.maxTokens || 4000;\n    const maxMessages = strategy.maxMessages || 20;\n\n    const messages: ChatMessage[] = [];\n    let tokenCount = 0;\n    const queryTokens = this.estimateTokens(currentQuery);\n\n    // 从后往前遍历，保留尽可能多的消息\n    for (let i = history.length - 1; i &gt;= 0; i--) {\n      const msg = history[i];\n      const msgTokens = this.estimateTokens(msg.content || msg.query || '');\n\n      // 检查是否超过限制（预留一些空间给当前查询和响应）\n      if (tokenCount + msgTokens + queryTokens &gt; maxTokens * 0.8) {\n        // 超过限制，对剩余消息生成摘要\n        if (i &gt; 0) {\n          const remainingMessages = history.slice(0, i);\n          const summary = await this.generateSummary(remainingMessages);\n          \n          if (summary) {\n            messages.unshift({\n              role: 'system',\n              content: &#96;历史对话摘要：${summary}&#96;\n            });\n          }\n        }\n        break;\n      }\n\n      messages.unshift(this.toMessage(msg));\n      tokenCount += msgTokens;\n\n      // 也限制消息数量\n      if (messages.length &gt;= maxMessages) {\n        // 如果还有更多消息，生成摘要\n        if (i &gt; 0) {\n          const remainingMessages = history.slice(0, i);\n          const summary = await this.generateSummary(remainingMessages);\n          \n          if (summary) {\n            messages.unshift({\n              role: 'system',\n              content: &#96;历史对话摘要：${summary}&#96;\n            });\n          }\n        }\n        break;\n      }\n    }\n\n    return messages;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 生成摘要\n   * @param messages 消息列表\n   * @returns 摘要文本\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class TriggerAgentUseCase {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 构建对话数据，包含根据contextWindowSize截取的上下文历史\n   * 此方法适用于所有工具（五看、三定、技术矩阵、传播、展具与视频、翻译等）\n   * @param conversation 对话对象\n   * @param conversationQuery 对话查询内容\n   * @param targetSources 目标来源\n   * @param dto 触发Agent的DTO，包含contextWindowSize参数\n   * @returns 包含历史上下文的对话数据\n   */\n  private buildConversationData(\n    conversation: any,\n    conversationQuery: string,\n    targetSources: any[],\n    dto: TriggerAgentDTO\n  ) {\n    const sortedMessages = [...(conversation.messages || [])];\n    // 根据contextWindowSize构建上下文（最近N条消息或全部历史）\n    // contextWindowSize: 5/10/20 表示最近N条消息，0 表示全部历史\n    const context = buildConversationContext(sortedMessages, {\n      historyLimit: dto.contextWindowSize,\n    });\n\n    // 获取最后一条助手消息和用户消息，用于字段映射\n    const lastAssistantMessage = [...sortedMessages].reverse().find((m) =&gt; m.role === 'assistant');\n    const lastUserMessage = [...sortedMessages].reverse().find((m) =&gt; m.role === 'user');\n\n    return {\n      query: conversationQuery,\n      sources: targetSources,\n      files: [],\n      history: context.history, // 根据contextWindowSize截取的历史消息\n      historyLimit: context.historyLimit,\n      historySize: context.historySize,\n      summary: context.summary,\n      keyPhrases: context.keyPhrases,\n      // 子Agent（如五看、三定等）每次调用都是独立的分析任务\n      // 不需要传递 conversationId，让 Dify 创建新的对话\n      conversationId: '',\n      featureType: dto.featureType,\n      lastAssistantMessage: lastAssistantMessage || undefined,\n      lastUserMessage: lastUserMessage || undefined,\n    };\n  }\n}",

        "range": {

            "line": 384,
            "column": 1

        },
        "contents": "export class AgentOrchestrator {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行 Agent（核心方法）\n   * @param roleId 角色ID\n   * @param query 用户查询\n   * @param conversationId 对话ID（可选，如果不存在会生成新的）\n   * @param context 上下文数据（用于变量替换）\n   * @returns 执行结果\n   */\n  async executeAgent(\n    roleId: string,\n    query: string,\n    conversationId: string = '',\n    context: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {}\n  ): Promise&lt;AgentExecutionResult&gt; {\n    const startTime = Date.now();\n    const MAX_EXECUTION_TIME = 360000; // 6分钟总体超时（留出缓冲给前端7分钟超时）\n    \n    // 检查超时的辅助函数\n    const checkTimeout = () =&gt; {\n      const elapsed = Date.now() - startTime;\n      if (elapsed &gt; MAX_EXECUTION_TIME) {\n        throw new Error(&#96;Agent执行超时：已执行 ${Math.round(elapsed / 1000)} 秒，超过最大执行时间 ${MAX_EXECUTION_TIME / 1000} 秒&#96;);\n      }\n    };\n    \n    // 1. 获取 Agent 配置\n    checkTimeout();\n    const role = await aiRoleModel.getById(roleId);\n    if (!role) {\n      throw new Error(&#96;AI角色不存在: ${roleId}&#96;);\n    }\n\n    if (!role.agentConfig) {\n      throw new Error(&#96;Agent配置不存在: ${roleId}&#96;);\n    }\n\n    const config = role.agentConfig;\n\n    // 2. 生成或使用 conversationId\n    const finalConversationId = conversationId || this.generateConversationId();\n\n    // 3. 渲染 System Prompt\n    const systemPrompt = this.promptManager.renderPrompt(\n      config.prompt.systemPrompt,\n      config.prompt.variables || [],\n      context\n    );\n\n    // 4. 获取上下文消息\n    checkTimeout();\n    const contextMessages = await this.contextManager.getContextMessages(\n      finalConversationId,\n      config.contextStrategy,\n      query\n    );\n\n    // 5. 构建完整消息列表\n    const messages: ChatMessage[] = [];\n    \n    // 根据策略决定是否包含 system prompt\n    if (config.contextStrategy.includeSystemPrompt || contextMessages.length === 0) {\n      messages.push({\n        role: 'system',\n        content: systemPrompt\n      });\n    }\n\n    messages.push(...contextMessages);\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class SendMessageUseCase {\nprivate async buildConversationData(\n    params: {\n      conversation: any | null;\n      content: string;\n      sources?: any[];\n      files?: Express.Multer.File[];\n      contextWindowSize?: number;\n      workflowId?: string;\n      fileList?: string;\n      knowledgeBaseNames?: string;\n    }\n  ) {\n\n    let additionalContext = '';\n    \n    const textContents: string[] = [];\n    \n    // 只在第一次对话时，提取外部来源的文本内容（description）\n    if (isFirstMessage) {\n      const externalTextSources = effectiveSources.filter((s: any) =&gt; \n        s.type === 'external' &amp;&amp; s.description &amp;&amp; s.description.trim()\n      );\n      \n      externalTextSources.forEach((source: any) =&gt; {\n        if (source.description &amp;&amp; source.description.trim()) {\n          const title = source.title || '附加信息';\n          textContents.push(&#96;【${title}】\\n${source.description.trim()}&#96;);\n        }\n      });\n    }\n    \n    // 文件的markdown内容总是添加（无论是否第一次对话）\n    if (fileMarkdownContents.length &gt; 0) {\n      textContents.push(...fileMarkdownContents);\n    }\n    \n    if (textContents.length &gt; 0) {\n      additionalContext = '\\n\\n=== 附加信息（文件内容） ===\\n' + textContents.join('\\n\\n---\\n\\n');\n      logger.info('提取附加信息（外部来源和文件markdown）', {\n        isFirstMessage,\n        filesCount: fileMarkdownContents.length,\n        totalTextLength: additionalContext.length,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // 将附加信息合并到 query 中\n    // 文件的markdown内容总是添加，外部来源的文本内容仅在第一次对话时添加\n    let finalQuery = params.content;\n    if (additionalContext) {\n      finalQuery = params.content + additionalContext;\n      logger.info('合并附加信息到查询内容', {\n        isFirstMessage,\n        originalLength: params.content.length,\n        additionalLength: additionalContext.length,\n        finalLength: finalQuery.length,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // 检查上一条消息是否是子Agent（工具箱）生成的内容\n    // 主Agent和子Agent交叉对话的逻辑：\n    // 1. 主对话使用同一个 dify_conversation_id 保持多轮对话\n    // 2. 子Agent（五看、三定等）处理上下文窗口内容，生成分析结果\n    // 3. 当用户继续主对话时，如果上一条是子Agent的输出，则将其作为上下文传递给主Agent\n    let toolOutputContext = '';\n    if (!isFirstMessage &amp;&amp; context.history &amp;&amp; context.history.length &gt; 0) {\n      // 找到最后一条助手消息\n      const lastAssistantMessage = [...context.history]\n        .reverse()\n        .find;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class ContentConcatenationService {\nasync buildContextFromSelectedItems(selectedItems: SelectionItem[]): Promise&lt;ConcatenatedContent&gt; {\n\n\n        // 根据选择的内容类型添加相应内容\n        for (const item of items) {\n          try {\n            const content = this.extractContentByType(associatedContent, techPointInfo, item.contentType);\n            if (content) {\n              contextString += this.formatContentByType(item.contentType, content);\n              contentTypeCounts[item.contentType]++;\n            } else {\n              const warningMsg = &#96;知识点 ${knowledgePointId} 的 ${item.contentType} 类型内容为空&#96;;\n              console.warn(warningMsg);\n              processingErrors.push(warningMsg);\n            }\n          } catch (contentError) {\n            const errorMsg = &#96;处理知识点 ${knowledgePointId} 的 ${item.contentType} 内容时出错: ${contentError instanceof Error ? contentError.message : '未知错误'}&#96;;\n            console.error(errorMsg);\n            processingErrors.push(errorMsg);\n          }\n        }\n\n        contextString += '\\n' + '='.repeat(50) + '\\n';\n      } catch (error) {\n        const errorMsg = &#96;处理知识点 ${knowledgePointId} 时出错: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'}&#96;;\n        console.error(errorMsg);\n        processingErrors.push(errorMsg);\n        // 继续处理其他知识点，不中断整个流程\n      }\n    }\n\n    const result: ConcatenatedContent = {\n      contextString: contextString.trim(),\n      summary: {\n        totalItems: selectedItems.length,\n        contentTypeCounts,\n        knowledgePointIds,\n        processingErrors: processingErrors.length &gt; 0 ? processingErrors : undefined,\n        stats\n      }\n    };\n\n    console.log('内容拼接完成:', {\n      contextLength: result.contextString.length,\n      processedKnowledgePoints: knowledgePointIds.length,\n      totalErrors: processingErrors.length\n    });\n\n    return result;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 批量获取知识点数据以提高性能\n   */\n  private async batchGetKnowledgePointData(knowledgePointIds: string[]): Promise&lt;Map&lt;string, { associatedContent: any; techPointInfo: any }&gt;&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class SendMessageUseCase {\nprivate async buildConversationData(\n    params: {\n      conversation: any | null;\n      content: string;\n      sources?: any[];\n      files?: Express.Multer.File[];\n      contextWindowSize?: number;\n      workflowId?: string;\n      fileList?: string;\n      knowledgeBaseNames?: string;\n    }\n  ) {\n\n,\n      });\n    }\n\n    return {\n      query: finalQuery,\n      summary: context.summary,\n      keyPhrases: context.keyPhrases,\n      sources: effectiveSources,\n      files:\n        params.files?.map((f) =&gt; ({\n          name: f.originalname,\n          url: &#96;/uploads/ai-search/${f.filename}&#96;,\n          type: f.mimetype,\n        })) || [],\n      fileList: fileListArray, // 文件列表数组\n      knowledgeBaseNames: knowledgeBaseNamesArray, // 知识库名称数组\n      // 注意：使用 Dify 的 conversation_id，不是本地对话ID\n      // 首次对话时为空，Dify 会返回新的 conversation_id\n      conversationId: params.conversation?.difyConversationId || '',\n      history: context.history,\n      historySize: context.historySize,\n      historyLimit: context.historyLimit,\n      metadata: {\n        contextGeneratedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        workflowId: params.workflowId,\n      },\n    };\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "import { logger } from '@/shared/lib/logger';\nimport { Result, failure, success } from '@/shared/lib/result';\n\nimport { ConversationSummaryView } from '../dto/GetConversations.dto';\n\nexport class GetConversationsUseCase {\n  constructor(private readonly aiSearchService: AiSearchService) {}\n\n  async execute(pageType?: string): Promise&lt;Result&lt;ConversationSummaryView[]&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      const conversations = await this.aiSearchService.getConversations(pageType);\n\n      // 为每个对话获取第一条用户消息（用于显示标题）\n      const formatted = await Promise.all(\n        conversations.map(async (conv) =&gt; {\n          // 获取第一条用户消息\n          const firstUserMessage = await this.aiSearchService.getFirstUserMessage(conv.id);\n          \n          return {\n            id: conv.id,\n            title: conv.title,\n            sources: JSON.parse(conv.sources || '[]'),\n            messages: firstUserMessage ? [firstUserMessage] : [],\n            createdAt: new Date(conv.created_at),\n            updatedAt: new Date(conv.updated_at),\n          };\n        })\n      );\n\n      return success(formatted);\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('获取对话列表失败', { error });\n      return failure({\n        code: 'GET_CONVERSATIONS_FAILED',\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '获取对话列表失败',\n        details: error,\n      });\n    }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class ExecuteAiSearchUseCase {\n\n\n  private async processInputs(inputs: Record&lt;string, unknown&gt; = {}) {\n    const processedInputs = { ...inputs } as Record&lt;string, unknown&gt;;\n\n    const selectedKnowledgePoints = inputs.selectedKnowledgePoints;\n    if (Array.isArray(selectedKnowledgePoints) &amp;&amp; selectedKnowledgePoints.length &gt; 0) {\n      try {\n        const contentService = createContentConcatenationService(db);\n        const concatenatedContent = await contentService.buildContextFromSelectedItems(selectedKnowledgePoints);\n\n        processedInputs.knowledgeContext = concatenatedContent.contextString;\n        processedInputs.knowledgeContextSummary = concatenatedContent.summary;\n        processedInputs.originalSelectedKnowledgePoints = selectedKnowledgePoints;\n      } catch (error) {\n        logger.error('知识点内容拼接失败', { error });\n        processedInputs.knowledgeContextError = error instanceof Error ? error.message : '内容拼接失败';\n      }\n    }\n\n    return processedInputs;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class ChatMessageService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 保存Dify聊天响应到数据库\n   */\n  static async saveDifyChatResponse(\n    response: DifyChatResponse,\n    userQuery: string,\n    appType: string,\n    inputs?: any\n  ): Promise&lt;{ conversation: ConversationRecord; userMessage: ChatMessageRecord; assistantMessage: ChatMessageRecord }&gt; {\n    // 1. 创建或更新对话会话\n    const conversation = await this.upsertConversation({\n      conversation_id: response.conversation_id,\n      app_type: appType,\n      session_name: userQuery.substring(0, 50) + (userQuery.length &gt; 50 ? '...' : ''),\n      status: 'active'\n    });\n\n    // 2. 保存用户消息\n    const userMessage = await this.saveChatMessage({\n      message_id: &#96;user_${response.id}_${Date.now()}&#96;,\n      conversation_id: response.conversation_id,\n      task_id: response.task_id,\n      message_type: 'user',\n      content: userQuery,\n      query: userQuery,\n      inputs: inputs ? JSON.stringify(inputs) : undefined,\n      app_type: appType,\n      status: 'completed'\n    });\n\n    // 3. 保存AI助手消息\n    const assistantMessage = await this.saveChatMessage({\n      message_id: response.id,\n      conversation_id: response.conversation_id,\n      task_id: response.task_id,\n      message_type: 'assistant',\n      content: response.answer,\n      app_type: appType,\n      dify_event: response.event,\n      dify_mode: response.mode,\n      dify_answer: response.answer,\n      prompt_tokens: response.metadata?.usage?.prompt_tokens,\n      completion_tokens: response.metadata?.usage?.completion_tokens,\n      total_tokens: response.metadata?.usage?.total_tokens,\n      total_price: response.metadata?.usage?.total_price,\n      currency: response.metadata?.usage?.currency,\n      latency: response.metadata?.usage?.latency,\n      retriever_resources: response.metadata?.retriever_resources ?         "contents": "export class AgentOrchestrator {\nasync executeAgent(\n    roleId: string,\n    query: string,\n    conversationId: string = '',\n    context: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {}\n  ): Promise&lt;AgentExecutionResult&gt; {\n;\n    }\n\n    messages.push(...contextMessages);\n    messages.push({\n      role: 'user',\n      content: query\n    });\n\n    // 6. 准备工具定义（Function Calling）\n    const tools = this.prepareTools(config.tools || []);\n\n    // 7. 获取 LLM Provider\n    const provider = this.getProvider(config.llm);\n\n    // 8. 调用 LLM（可能包含多轮工具调用）\n    checkTimeout();\n    let response = await this.executeWithTools(provider, messages, config.llm, tools, config.tools || [], checkTimeout);\n\n    // 9. 保存消息历史\n    await this.saveMessages(finalConversationId, query, response, roleId);\n\n    // 10. 返回结果\n    return {\n      content: response.content,\n      conversationId: finalConversationId,\n      usage: response.usage,\n      metadata: {\n        model: response.model,\n        finishReason: response.finishReason,\n        toolCalls: response.toolCalls?.length || 0\n      }\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 执行带工具调用的 LLM 请求（可能多轮）\n   */\n  private async executeWithTools(\n    provider: ILLMProvider,\n    messages: ChatMessage[],\n    llmConfig: LLMConfig,\n    tools: Tool[],\n    toolConfigs: ToolConfig[],\n    checkTimeout?: () =&gt; void\n  ): Promise&lt;LLMResponse&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class SendMessageUseCase {\nprivate async buildConversationData(\n    params: {\n      conversation: any | null;\n      content: string;\n      sources?: any[];\n      files?: Express.Multer.File[];\n      contextWindowSize?: number;\n      workflowId?: string;\n      fileList?: string;\n      knowledgeBaseNames?: string;\n    }\n  ) {\n\n    let toolOutputContext = '';\n    if (!isFirstMessage &amp;&amp; context.history &amp;&amp; context.history.length &gt; 0) {\n      // 找到最后一条助手消息\n      const lastAssistantMessage = [...context.history]\n        .reverse()\n        .find((msg: any) =&gt; msg.role === 'assistant');\n      \n      // 检查最后一条助手消息是否是子Agent的输出（hasOutputs 为 true 表示是工具生成的）\n      if (lastAssistantMessage &amp;&amp; lastAssistantMessage.hasOutputs) {\n        // 获取工具类型标签\n        const featureType = (params.conversation?.messages || [])\n          .find((m: any) =&gt; m.id === lastAssistantMessage.id)?.outputs?.metadata?.featureType;\n        const toolLabel = featureType ? this.getFeatureLabel(featureType) : '子Agent分析';\n        \n        // 将子Agent的输出作为上下文\n        const contentPreview = lastAssistantMessage.content.length &gt; 2000\n          ? lastAssistantMessage.content.substring(0, 2000) + '\\n...(内容已截断)'\n          : lastAssistantMessage.content;\n        \n        toolOutputContext = &#96;\\n\\n=== ${toolLabel}结果（请参考以下内容继续对话）===\\n${contentPreview}&#96;;\n        \n        logger.info('检测到上一条消息是子Agent输出，将其作为上下文', {\n          messageId: lastAssistantMessage.id,\n          featureType: featureType || 'unknown',\n          toolLabel,\n          contentLength: lastAssistantMessage.content.length,\n          truncated: lastAssistantMessage.content.length &gt; 2000,\n        });\n      }\n    }\n    \n    // 将子Agent输出上下文合并到 query 中\n    if (toolOutputContext) {\n      finalQuery = finalQuery + toolOutputContext;\n      logger.info('合并子Agent输出到查询内容', {\n        originalLength: params.content.length,\n        contextLength: toolOutputContext.length,\n        finalLength: finalQuery.length,\n      });\n    }\n\n    return {\n      query: finalQuery,\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TriggerAgentUseCase {\nasync execute(conversationId: string, dto: TriggerAgentDTO): Promise&lt;Result&lt;any&gt;&gt; {\n\n\n      const messageOutputs = {\n        ...extractedOutput,\n        metadata: {\n          ...(extractedOutput.metadata || {}),\n          featureType: dto.featureType,\n          workflowId: targetWorkflowId,\n          sourceMessageId: dto.messageId || null,\n          executionId: (workflowResult as any).executionId || null,\n          triggeredAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n          workflowInput,\n          baseContent: conversationQuery,\n          context: {\n            historySize: conversationData.history?.length || 0,\n            historyLimit: conversationData.historyLimit,\n            summary: conversationData.summary,\n            keyPhrases: conversationData.keyPhrases,\n          },\n        },\n      };\n\n      const aiMessage = await this.aiSearchService.sendMessage(\n        conversationId,\n        'assistant',\n        aiContent,\n        targetSources,\n        [],\n        messageOutputs\n      );\n\n      return success({\n        message: formatMessageRecord(aiMessage),\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('子Agent执行失败', { error });\n      return failure({\n        code: 'TRIGGER_AGENT_FAILED',\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '子Agent执行失败',\n        details: error,\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async resolveBaseContent(conversation: any, dto: TriggerAgentDTO) {\n    \n  }\n}",

mapping.config.featureObjects \n            : [];\n          \n          // 查找第一个匹配当前 pageType 的 featureObject，使用其 workflowId 作为默认工作流\n          const matchedFeature = featureObjects.find((f: any) =&gt; \n            f.pageType &amp;&amp; pageKeys.includes(f.pageType)\n          );\n          \n          if (matchedFeature) {\n            const workflowId = matchedFeature.workflowId || mapping.workflowId;\n            // 验证工作流是否在可用列表中\n            if (availableWorkflows.some(w =&gt; w.id === workflowId)) {\n              setDefaultWorkflowFromMapping(workflowId);\n              console.log(&#96;[BaseAISearchPage] 从字段映射配置找到 ${config.pageType} 的默认工作流:&#96;, workflowId);\n              return;\n            }\n          }\n        }\n        \n        // 如果没有找到匹配的，尝试使用该工作流配置中的第一个工作流\n        // 查找所有为该 pageType 配置的工作流，使用第一个\n        const allWorkflowsForPage = new Set&lt;string&gt;();\n        for (const mapping of mappings) {\n          const featureObjects = Array.isArray(mapping.config?.featureObjects) \n            ? mapping.config.featureObjects \n            : [];\n          \n          const hasMatchingPageType = featureObjects.some((f: any) =&gt; \n            f.pageType &amp;&amp; pageKeys.includes(f.pageType)\n          );\n          \n          if (hasMatchingPageType) {\n            allWorkflowsForPage.add(mapping.workflowId);\n          }\n        }\n        \n        // 使用第一个匹配的工作流\n        if (allWorkflowsForPage.size &gt; 0) {\n          const firstWorkflowId = Array.from(allWorkflowsForPage)[0];\n          if (availableWorkflows.some(w =&gt; w.id === firstWorkflowId)) {\n            setDefaultWorkflowFromMapping(firstWorkflowId);\n            console.log(&#96;[BaseAISearchPage] 从字段映射配置找到 ${config.pageType} 的默认工作流（使用工作流配置）:&#96;, firstWorkflowId);\n            return;\n          }\n        }\n        \n        setDefaultWorkflowFromMapping(null);\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('[BaseAISearchPage] 加载字段映射配置失败:', error);\n        setDefaultWorkflowFromMapping(null);\n      }\n    };\n\n    if (availableWorkflows.length &gt; 0) {\n      loadDefaultWorkflowFromMapping();\n    }\n  }, [config.pageType, availableWorkflows]);\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const selectionMap = workflowSelectionRef.current;\n    const conversationId = currentConversation?.id;\n\n    const workflowIds = new Set(availableWorkflows.map((workflow) =&gt; workflow.id));",

## 实现总结

已实现从项目资源页面跳转到技术策略/技术包装页面时的信息传递。

### 实现的功能：

1. **对话内容总结**（在 `ProjectResourcesPage.tsx`）：
   - 点击“技术策略”或“技术包装”按钮时，自动收集当前对话历史
   - 使用 AI 生成标题和摘要
   - 如果 AI 调用失败，使用简化版本（拼接对话内容）

2. **保存为来源信息**：
   - 将对话摘要保存到数据库，关联到目标页面类型（`tech-strategy` 或 `tech-package`）
   - 作为外部来源（`external`）保存

3. **自动跳转并选中**（在 `BaseAISearchPage.tsx`）：
   - 跳转时在 URL 中传递新创建的 `sourceId`
   - 目标页面加载时自动检测 URL 参数中的 `sourceId`
   - 来源加载完成后自动选中该来源
   - 选中后清除 URL 参数，避免刷新时重复选中

4. **用户体验优化**：
   - 添加加载状态指示器，显示“正在总结对话...”
   - 总结过程中禁用按钮，防止重复点击

### 技术细节：

- 使用 `sourceService.saveSourceInformation` 保存来源信息
- 使用 `useSearchParams` 处理 URL 参数
- 通过 `useEffect` 监听 sources 变化，确保在来源加载完成后再选中
- 支持与项目 ID 同时传递，兼容现有 URL 参数

功能已实现并测试通过，无 lint 错误。用户从项目资源页面点击“技术策略”或“技术包装”后，对话内容会被总结并自动添加到目标页面的 SourceSidebar 中，并自动勾选。

已实现技术转译内容的保存和自动选中功能。总结如下：

## 新增功能

### 1. 保存技术转译内容为来源信息（在 `ProjectResourcesPage.tsx`）
- 新增 `saveTechnicalTranslationAsSource`：
  - 检查是否存在 `translatedContent`
  - 从内容提取标题（移除 markdown 标记）
  - 将转译内容保存为外部来源，关联到目标页面类型

### 2. 更新跳转逻辑
- 修改 `handleNavigateToAIPage`：
  - 同时保存对话摘要和技术转译内容（如果存在）
  - 使用 `URLSearchParams` 支持多个 `sourceId` 参数
  - URL 格式：`/tech-package?projectId=3&sourceId=xxx&sourceId=yyy`

### 3. 支持多个来源自动选中（在 `BaseAISearchPage.tsx`）
- 更新 URL 参数处理：
  - 使用 `searchParams.getAll('sourceId')` 获取所有 `sourceId`
  - 检查每个 `sourceId` 是否存在，并自动选中
  - 同时选中多个来源（对话摘要和技术转译）

## 工作流程

1. 用户在项目资源页面进行技术转译，生成 `translatedContent`
2. 用户点击“技术策略”或“技术包装”
3. 系统自动：
   - 总结对话内容并保存为来源（如果存在对话）
   - 保存技术转译内容为来源（如果存在转译）
   - 跳转到目标页面，URL 中包含所有新创建的 `sourceId`
4. 目标页面加载后：
   - 自动加载所有来源
   - 自动选中 URL 参数中指定的所有来源
   - 清除 URL 参数，避免刷新时重复选中

## 代码质量
- 无 lint 错误
- 完整的错误处理和日志记录
- 支持对话内容和技术转译内容同时传递
